short_description.text: Hosea — the prophet of the book of Hosea (HOS 1:1).
Jezreel — son of Hosea and Gomer (HOS 1:4).
Aven is a place named in Scripture (Hos.10.8).
Beth-arbel is a place named in Scripture (Hos.10.14).

Shittim is a place named in Scripture (Hos.5.2–Num.25.1).
Valley of Achor is a place named in Scripture (Hos.2.15–Josh.15.7).

where.text: The northern kingdom amid prosperity and idolatry.

when.text: Eighth century BC in the northern kingdom.

what.text: Hosea's marriage to Gomer pictures God's faithful love for unfaithful Israel, with calls to return and warnings of judgment. Genre: Prophecy.

before.text: Addresses the fall of Samaria and Assyrian threat.

stakes.text: God's covenant love endures despite Israel's betrayal.
